cohort: 2,235 pregnant women who delivered between January 2013 and May 2018 at King Abdulaziz University Hospital (KAUH), Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Of these, 1,842 were included in the study.
finding: The study found a high prevalence of obesity (24.6%) among pregnant women in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, which was significantly associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was found to be statistically significant with adverse pregnancy outcomes (p < 0.05).
